Name: Spinning Weapon And Tool Mod (No Longer Maintained)
Author: Darkmushu1
Description:
I'm quitting modding to explore other things in life, whoever wants to take over the project and or maintain just let me know and I can add a redirect link here to your Nexus mod page.

[b]Description[/b]
Creates spinning replicates of your weapon/tools that does Area of Effect at the cost of stamina or energy. This mod works fine by itself if ran on SMAPI but gets enhanced with the various optional mods: If you use Unified Experience System as well then, this mod will have level up system for each spinning ability and allow you to choose to use Energy as "cooldown" instead of draining your stamina, GMCM drastically eases configuration, and Iconic Framework adds nice Icons that can be leveraged. If you want to use the mod as a standalone mode, make sure you use Generic Mod Config Menu to update the mod from "unified experience system" to standalone. Also set to use stamina instead of energy.

[b]Energy Drain[/b]
Stamina drain configuration also applies the same amount to Energy Drain. Energy gets consumed and doesn't regen unless no ability has been cast within the last few seconds acting as a global cooldown for all abilities.

[b]How to use:[/b]
Right click when using a weapon or certain tools to trigger the spin effect. The spin effect will drain your stamina and applies area damage or area application.

[b]Configurable[/b]:
Lots of settings to aid in manual balancing
Spin hotkey right click,  Controller A Button,  Mobile use Iconic Framework Mod Icon to toggle on and off, if toggle don't work click on another tool or inventory slot to cancel spin.

[b]Platform Support[/b]
Works on PC, Linux (steam Deck), and Android (mobile)
